theme.en: Memory and infrastructure set AI's pace
theme.zh: 存储与基础设施决定AI扩张节奏

dek.en: New memory investment, higher-bandwidth flash, and denser cooling point to the physical systems now constraining AI deployment. Reports of foundry progress and a China packaging divestment show that supply-chain geography remains part of the equation.
dek.zh: 新增存储投资、高带宽闪存与更高密度散热方案表明，制约AI部署的瓶颈正更多落在物理基础设施上。代工进展与中国封装资产处置的报道也显示，供应链地理布局仍是关键变量。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Delta targets 150 kW liquid-to-air cooling for NVL72 racks
title.zh: Delta面向NVL72机架推出150kW液对气散热方案

summary.en: Delta introduced the GoCool-150 liquid-to-air cooling distribution unit for ASRock Rack's NVIDIA VR NVL72 deployments, with a stated 150 kW heat-dissipation target. The announcement illustrates how rack-level thermal management is becoming a first-order design constraint as GPU systems move beyond conventional air-cooling envelopes.
summary.zh: Delta发布了面向ASRock Rack NVIDIA VR NVL72部署的GoCool-150液对气冷却分配单元，标称散热能力为150kW。这一方案说明，随着GPU系统的功耗密度超出传统风冷范围，机架级热管理正成为一项一阶设计约束。

title.en: Taiwan retailer bundles RTX 5090 with eight motherboards
title.zh: 台湾零售商将RTX 5090与八块主板捆绑销售

summary.en: Taiwanese retailer PChome24h is reportedly selling RTX 5090 cards only inside bundles that include eight motherboards and additional components. The practice is a retail-market signal rather than a change to Nvidia's product roadmap, but it underscores continued distortion in access to high-end GPUs.
summary.zh: 据报道，台湾零售商PChome24h仅以捆绑形式销售RTX 5090，套装包含八块主板及其他组件。这并不代表Nvidia产品路线图发生变化，但这种零售行为反映出高端GPU获取渠道仍存在扭曲。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Report says TSMC advances 3 nm output and 1.4 nm construction
title.zh: 报道称台积电提前推进3nm产能与1.4nm厂房建设

summary.en: Tech Times reports that TSMC has accelerated 3 nm output by several months and that construction of a 1.4 nm facility is ahead of schedule. The report should be treated as an early supply-chain signal rather than confirmed company guidance, yet it highlights the market's focus on the timing of leading-edge capacity.
summary.zh: Tech Times报道称，台积电将3nm产出提前数月推进，且1.4nm工厂建设进度领先于计划。该消息应视为早期供应链信号，而非公司已确认的指引；但它凸显市场正密切关注先进制程产能的落地时点。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储器

title.en: SK hynix commits $38 billion to two new chip fabs
title.zh: SK hynix投入380亿美元建设两座新晶圆厂

summary.en: SK hynix is reported to be spending $38 billion on two new chip fabs. The scale of the proposed build-out reinforces that memory suppliers are treating AI-driven demand as a capacity and manufacturing-cycle issue, not only a short-term HBM pricing opportunity.
summary.zh: 据报道，SK hynix将投入380亿美元建设两座新晶圆厂。如此规模的扩产说明，存储厂商正把AI驱动的需求视为产能和制造周期问题，而不只是短期HBM价格机会。

title.en: SanDisk unveils a high-bandwidth flash standard
title.zh: SanDisk发布高带宽闪存标准

summary.en: SanDisk has unveiled what the report describes as the first high-bandwidth flash standard. Flash is not a substitute for HBM, but a faster and more standardized tier could matter for data-heavy AI pipelines that need to move more data between storage and compute.
summary.zh: SanDisk发布了报道所称的首个高带宽闪存标准。闪存并不能替代HBM，但更快且更标准化的存储层，可能会影响需要在存储与计算之间搬运大量数据的AI数据管线。

title.en: CXMT DDR5 reaches DDR5-8800 in an AMD-platform demonstration
title.zh: CXMT DDR5在AMD平台演示中达到DDR5-8800

summary.en: Colorful demonstrated DDR5-8800 memory kits using CXMT integrated circuits on an AMD platform, according to Tom's Hardware. An overclocking demonstration does not establish broad production parity, but it is a visible data point in China's effort to narrow the gap in advanced DRAM technology.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，Colorful在AMD平台上演示了采用CXMT芯片的DDR5-8800内存套装。超频演示并不等同于大规模量产性能对等，但它为中国缩小先进DRAM技术差距提供了一个可见的进展信号。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: SK hynix considers selling a Chongqing plant stake
title.zh: SK hynix考虑出售重庆半导体工厂股权

summary.en: SK hynix is considering a sale of its stake in a Chongqing semiconductor plant, according to a report carried by Reuters Technology's Google News feed. If pursued, the move would reshape the company's China manufacturing footprint and shows how memory supply chains are being reconsidered amid geopolitical and capital-allocation pressures.
summary.zh: 据Reuters Technology的Google News转引报道，SK hynix正考虑出售其在重庆一座半导体工厂的股权。若这一计划推进，将重塑该公司在中国的制造布局，也反映出存储供应链正受到地缘政治与资本配置压力的重新审视。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 挑战者

title.en: Analyst frames Nvidia's Groq bet around inference-token growth
title.zh: 分析师将Nvidia对Groq的布局解读为推理Token增长机会

summary.en: An analyst cited by Stocktwits argues that Nvidia's bet on Groq could expand inference-token demand and create another revenue path. The claim is an analyst view rather than company guidance, but it reflects the strategic value assigned to specialized low-latency inference systems alongside general-purpose GPUs.
summary.zh: Stocktwits援引的一位分析师认为，Nvidia对Groq的布局可能扩大推理Token需求，并形成新的收入路径。这是分析师观点而非公司指引，但它反映出市场正在重估专用低延迟推理系统与通用GPU并行发展的战略价值。

theme.zh: 存储系统正在成为加速器

dek.en: This week's papers move memory management, low-precision formats, and near-memory execution into the center of AI-system design. At the same time, measurement and EDA work targets the tools needed to validate those increasingly complex systems.
dek.zh: 本周论文将存储管理、低精度格式与近存计算推到AI系统设计的核心位置。与此同时，测量与EDA研究也在完善验证这些日益复杂系统所需的工具链。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: CMOS-compatible bismuth photodetector for SWIR silicon waveguides
title.zh: 面向短波红外硅波导的CMOS兼容铋光电探测器

papers.authors: Liqiang Qi, Jiaqi Wang, Zhibin Yang, et al.

summary.en: The authors directly grow a two-dimensional bismuth film at low temperature in a back-end CMOS-compatible flow to make a waveguide-integrated SWIR detector. At 2200 nm, the device reports about 2 dB/μm absorption, 185.3 mA/W responsivity, and 201.4 nA dark current. Transfer-free growth could make wafer-scale integration more practical, although performance will still need to be tested across full process variation and packaging conditions.
summary.zh: 作者采用与CMOS后段工艺兼容的低温直接生长方法，在硅波导上制备二维铋短波红外探测器。器件在2200nm处报告约2 dB/μm吸收系数、185.3 mA/W响应度和201.4 nA暗电流。免转移生长有望提升晶圆级集成可制造性，但仍需在完整工艺波动和封装条件下验证其性能。

title.en: Controlling self-focusing in femtosecond slicing of 4H-SiC wafers
title.zh: 4H-SiC晶圆飞秒激光切片中的自聚焦控制

papers.authors: Dong Hee Kang, Jaeseung Lim, Mishfaqur Rahman, et al.

summary.en: This work links Kerr-induced self-focusing during femtosecond laser slicing of 4H-SiC to pulse energy, processing depth, surface texture, and separation stress. The result provides a process-control route for producing thin SiC layers, which are increasingly relevant to power devices and heterogeneous integration. Its practical value will depend on throughput, yield, and equipment repeatability beyond the reported experiments.
summary.zh: 该研究将4H-SiC飞秒激光切片中的Kerr效应自聚焦与脉冲能量、加工深度、表面纹理和分离应力关联起来。结果为制备薄型SiC层提供了工艺控制路径，这对功率器件和异构集成日益重要。其工程价值仍取决于实验之外的吞吐量、良率与设备重复性。

title.en: Circuits & Systems
title.zh: 电路与系统

title.en: PowerScope: ML-based intra-cycle power estimation
title.zh: PowerScope：基于机器学习的周期内功耗估计

papers.authors: Jayanth Balasubramanian, Sujay Pandit, Radha Vaidya, et al.

summary.en: PowerScope estimates sub-cycle power directly from RTL simulation traces, avoiding per-workload post-layout gate-level analysis. Across its benchmark suite, it reports 5.88% median and 9% mean absolute percentage error versus commercial post-layout estimates while running roughly 80 times faster. That could shorten PDN and voltage-droop iteration, but the reported accuracy must transfer to new libraries and physical-design flows to be broadly useful.
summary.zh: PowerScope直接从RTL仿真轨迹估计子周期功耗，避免逐工作负载执行后布局门级功耗分析。在其基准套件上，系统相对商业后布局估计的中位绝对百分比误差为5.88%、平均误差为9%，速度约快80倍。这可能缩短PDN和压降分析迭代，但其准确性仍需迁移到新的标准单元库和物理设计流程中验证。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: PLoRA: pooled near-data memory for multi-LoRA serving
title.zh: PLoRA：用于多LoRA服务的近数据池化内存

papers.authors: Zhongkai Yu, Ohm Rishabh Venkatachalam, Zheng Wang, et al.

summary.en: PLoRA proposes placing LoRA adapters and KV cache in pooled memory with near-data processing, returning reduced results rather than repeatedly staging adapters through CPU DRAM and PCIe. Its runtime chooses among execution and caching strategies per adapter. The design directly addresses the memory-heavy nature of serving thousands of specialized adapters, but it depends on the availability and software maturity of coherent pooled-memory fabrics.
summary.zh: PLoRA提出将LoRA适配器和KV Cache置于带近数据处理能力的池化内存中，只返回规约结果，而非反复经由CPU DRAM和PCIe搬运适配器。其运行时会针对每个适配器选择执行与缓存策略。该设计直指数千个专用适配器服务的存储瓶颈，但依赖于一致性池化内存互连的可用性和软件成熟度。

title.en: KARAT splits sparse-attention serving across GPUs and processing-near-memory
title.zh: KARAT将稀疏注意力服务拆分至GPU与近存计算节点

papers.authors: Hyungkyu Ham, Junhyeong Bae, Seungheon Lee, et al.

summary.en: KARAT keeps model weights and projection or MoE work on GPUs while placing KV cache, retrieval indices, and their memory-reading operations on processing-near-memory nodes. The heterogeneous split is designed for retrieval-based sparse attention at very long context lengths. It is a useful architectural direction, although its benefit will hinge on link latency, scheduling overhead, and how quickly sparse-attention algorithms change.
summary.zh: KARAT将模型权重以及投影和MoE计算保留在GPU上，把KV Cache、检索索引及相应的内存读取操作放到近存计算节点。该异构划分针对超长上下文的检索式稀疏注意力设计。这是一条有价值的架构路径，但其收益取决于互连延迟、调度开销以及稀疏注意力算法的演进速度。

title.en: Chebyshev systolic array unifies activation and softmax approximation
title.zh: 基于Chebyshev的脉动阵列统一激活函数与Softmax近似

papers.authors: Benedikt Schaible, Anirudh Suresh Bharadwaj, Ulf Schlichtmann, et al.

summary.en: The paper uses Chebyshev-polynomial approximations in a systolic-array unit that handles both nonlinear activations and softmax. It reports up to 71% lower tanh mean absolute error than a CORDIC baseline with 4.6% less area and 5.1% less power, plus lower softmax KL divergence. Sharing hardware across these functions can improve accelerator utilization, though approximation quality remains workload and precision dependent.
summary.zh: 论文用Chebyshev多项式近似构建脉动阵列单元，同时处理非线性激活函数和Softmax。相对CORDIC基线，作者报告tanh平均绝对误差最高降低71%，面积减少4.6%、功耗降低5.1%，Softmax的KL散度也更低。跨函数共享硬件可提升加速器利用率，但近似精度仍取决于工作负载和数值精度。

title.en: AI Systems & Models
title.zh: AI系统与模型

title.en: AdaMX: heterogeneity-aware microscaling for low-bit LLM inference
title.zh: AdaMX：面向低比特LLM推理的异构感知微缩放

papers.authors: Junyi Luo, Xinting Jiang, Tai-Hao Wen, et al.

summary.en: AdaMX varies both the representation and precision-recovery scheme across quantization blocks and between weights and activations, rather than applying one MXFP4 treatment everywhere. The authors implement a 22 nm FD-SOI accelerator prototype and report about 1% system-energy overhead versus an otherwise identical MXFP4 design. The proposition is compelling because it targets accuracy lost to fixed formats, but its gains need comparison across models and production compiler stacks.
summary.zh: AdaMX不再对所有量化块统一采用一种MXFP4处理方式，而是分别调整表示格式和精度恢复方案，并区分权重与激活值。作者实现了22nm FD-SOI加速器原型，相比其他条件相同的MXFP4设计，系统能耗开销约为1%。该方法直指固定格式带来的精度损失，但其收益仍需在更多模型和生产级编译器栈上比较。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: EDATracer: evidence-grounded analysis across EDA artifacts
title.zh: EDATracer：跨EDA工件的证据可追溯分析

papers.authors: Phat Tieu, Sayanti Jana, Matthew DeLorenzo, et al.

summary.en: EDATracer combines a knowledge graph and vector index to let agents retrieve evidence across RTL and source files, scripts, logs, netlists, and reports. Its new dataset contains 18.9 GB from 2,787 synthesizable open-source designs and a 90-question benchmark; the paper reports average pass@1 gains of 6.4 and 7.2 percentage points over Cursor and Claude Code. The benchmark is a meaningful step toward auditable EDA agents, though performance on proprietary flows and tool outputs remains an open question.
summary.zh: EDATracer结合知识图谱与向量索引，使智能体能够跨RTL和源文件、脚本、日志、网表及报告检索证据。其新数据集包含来自2,787个可综合开源设计的18.9GB数据，并提供90道题的基准；论文报告其平均pass@1比Cursor和Claude Code分别高6.4和7.2个百分点。该基准推动EDA智能体走向可审计，但在专有流程和工具输出上的表现仍有待验证。

title.en: Quantum Computing
title.zh: 量子计算

title.en: Ant-Q addresses the control-memory bottleneck in quantum experiments
title.zh: Ant-Q缓解量子实验中的控制存储瓶颈

papers.authors: Yicheng Guang, Neel Vora, Yilun Xu, et al.

summary.en: Ant-Q combines DRAM and on-chip BRAM in a memory hierarchy intended to preserve deterministic timing while pipelining quantum-circuit execution. Across 26 experimental and computing circuits, the authors report reducing circuit-loading and readout-uplink overhead relative to execution time from 22.90–1417.05% to near zero. The work identifies control electronics as a throughput limiter, though integration into QubiC 3.0 will be the more consequential test of its real-world impact.
summary.zh: Ant-Q将DRAM与片上BRAM组合成存储层级，旨在在流水化执行量子电路时保持确定性时序。作者在26个实验和计算电路上报告，将相对执行时间为22.90%至1417.05%的电路加载与读出上行开销降至接近零。该研究指出控制电子学是吞吐量限制因素，但其集成到QubiC 3.0后的表现才是更关键的实际检验。
